title: External Application Accuracy Contract and Runtime Policy Seam
purpose: Materialize a narrow immutable/shareable runtime contract that can carry an externally supplied groundwater head or drawdown application requirement and an independently supplied temporal allocation, validate their provenance/semantics, and compose them into the existing generic model_temporal_indicator_budget carrier without selecting any numeric policy.

ownership.canonical_numerical_config_role: consumer carrier only; model_temporal_indicator_budget_available/value already exist and remain generic/model-owned
ownership.forbidden: Do not store H_app, A_temporal, application provenance, receptor semantics or decision-threshold semantics directly in canonical_numerical_config_t.

contract_semantics.H_app: positive finite externally supplied application prediction-accuracy requirement in the supported head-domain quantity of interest
contract_semantics.A_temporal: positive finite independently supplied fraction of H_app allocated to temporal/coupling numerical error; 0 < A_temporal <= 1
contract_semantics.composition_claim: pure policy composition only; multiplication does not qualify either input or make F-GC07 a physical truth/error-bound guarantee
contract_semantics.absence_semantics: absence is explicit and valid as an unconfigured contract state; it must never imply a positive fallback budget

provenance_semantics.contract_id: positive integer reference into external/runtime policy registry
provenance_semantics.application_provenance_id: positive integer reference; immutable external requirement provenance
provenance_semantics.memory_rule: per-column runtime state carries only compact IDs/scalars; strings/documents remain outside the kernel and may be shared in registries

qualification_matrix: unconfigured contract has no materializable temporal budget
H_app without A_temporal has no materializable temporal budget
A_temporal without H_app has no materializable temporal budget
materialization only writes existing generic model temporal budget carrier and does not alter transaction/mass policy
source_mutation_allowlist: one new runtime/coupler-facing application accuracy contract module
fail_closed_rule: Any need for a built-in numeric H_app/A_temporal, silent fallback, coupling-target tuning, duplicated budget path, or relaxation of hard mass conservation closes F-GC09 unqualified.
